title: Sandustry Gameplay Overview — Dig, Refine, Automate on a Sand Planet
description: Sandustry gameplay overview: core fantasy, who it is for, platform and community, EA expectations, FAQ, and links to beginner paths.

paragraphs: Sandustry mixes destructible terrain with factory logistics. You reshape a sand planet pixel by pixel, extract value, and grow toward self-running production.
Steam describes a vast open world of biomes and industrial progression — from humble wet-sand refining toward deeper secrets and more complex chains.
It sits closer to sandbox automation than to combat roguelikes. The “enemy” is usually clogged flow, floods, and your own layout debt.
Sort and move materials with logistics buildings.
Refine and process toward valuable outputs.
Expand automation until the factory runs with less babysitting.
Unlock more buildings, resources, chains, quests, and technologies across Early Access.
Players who like digging, belt puzzles, and watching systems stabilize.
Players who accept Early Access: UI, balance, and content still move.
Less ideal if you want pure action combat, a finished content checklist, or zero debugging.
PC via Steam (main app 2764460; free demo 3490390).
Community hubs: Discord, Reddit r/SandustryGame, YouTube @sandustry.
Official documentation: Hooded Horse Sandustry wiki.
Developer / publisher: Lantto Games / Hooded Horse.

Start with the Beginner Guide or Demo Guide depending on whether you already own EA.

faq.a: Treat single-player factory focus as the default pitch unless Steam features explicitly list multiplayer for your build. Always re-check the store page.

faq.q: Is Sandustry like Factorio / Noita / other sandboxes?
faq.a: It shares factory-automation DNA and destructible-pixel vibes, but you should judge it on the Steam demo rather than analogy charts.

faq.q: Where do I start on this site?
faq.a: Demo Guide if undecided; Beginner Guide if you already own Early Access; Automation Tips when belts hurt.
